identification.instruction: Look for white top and gray sides
identification.quote: have a white top and gray sides

identification.instruction: Look for 'Room & Board' embroidered on one end

remedy.text: Stop using the crib mattress and contact Room & Board for a full refund.
remedy.quote: Consumers should immediately stop using the crib mattresses and contact Room & Board to receive a full refund.

remedy.text: Restwell Mattress Co. and Room & Board will contact purchasers and arrange free pickup.
remedy.quote: Restwell Mattress Co. and Room & Board are contacting all purchasers directly and will arrange for pick up at no charge.

title: Restwell Mattress Recalls Room & Board Crib Mattresses Due to Suffocation Hazard for Infants; Failure to Comply with Federal Safety Standard for Crib Mattresses; Sold Exclusively at Room & Board (Recall Alert)
